caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture, rectangular in shape with a slanted top surface. The front and side panels are smooth and feature a deep brown wood grain. The legs have decorative cut-outs, adding an ornamental touch to the otherwise simple design. Resting on the top surface is a green fabric with an embroidered floral pattern; the pattern features red and yellow flowers with green foliage, arranged in a horizontal band across the fabric. The edges of the fabric are decorated with small, round, white elements, possibly buttons or beads. The drawing is set against a plain, light background with no other objects visible. In the lower right corner, the name “Richard Taylor” is written in small handwriting.
title: Bootjack with Needlepoint Top
